zones.name: The Severed Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: Multi-level area with elevator (L1: The Spine, L2: Apartments), bridge, locked doors, and a bowl/pond with NPC Shii

zones.name: L1: The Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: First floor of The Severed Spine elevator; bridge with NPCs, locked door requiring Aviaries Passepartout

zones.name: L2: Apartments
zones.fingerprintHint: Second floor of The Severed Spine elevator; enemies on bottom floor and chandelier, leads to Dwellings

zones.name: Dwellings
zones.fingerprintHint: Frozen/icy outdoor zone, gliding on icy surfaces, locked gate leading to Metropolis, NPC Rostam

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.note: Referenced by NPC Rostam as destination through locked gate in Dwellings; not yet visited in this segment
zones.fingerprintHint: Beyond locked gate in Dwellings, mentioned but not entered

abilities.name: Silo Access Badge
abilities.grants: Opens locked door near Nexus Attuner in early area
abilities.note: Required for a locked door; not yet obtained in this segment

abilities.name: Aviaries Passepartout
abilities.grants: Opens locked door on L1: The Spine leading to further right area
abilities.note: Required for door on the right of L1 bridge; not yet obtained in this segment

abilities.name: Map
abilities.note: Unlocked by offering enough Nacre to the Pond (bowl) near Shii; cannot be obtained yet without enough Nacre to farm

milestones.name: Nexus Attuner reached
milestones.note: First checkpoint/save point discovered; healing and saving mechanic introduced

milestones.name: Entered The Severed Spine
milestones.note: Reached via pipes from Nexus Attuner room

milestones.name: Met Samsk via Strange Tube
milestones.note: Interacting with Strange Tube in hidden grate area triggers dialogue with NPC Samsk, who asks player to find Tomo

milestones.name: Met Shii at the Pond
milestones.note: After dying and respawning at Attuner with 50 Nacres, player can speak with Shii on the upper level of The Severed Spine; Nacre offering mechanic unlocked

milestones.name: Entered Dwellings
milestones.note: Reached by going outside through door on left from upper section of L2: Apartments

milestones.name: Met Rostam
milestones.note: NPC Rostam at locked gate in Dwellings reveals gate leads to Metropolis

milestones.name: Health bar lost
milestones.note: A cutscene triggers on the bridge causing the player to lose one health bar permanently

milestones.name: Nacre droplets lost — 50 Nacres
milestones.note: Player intentionally dies on red vines in L2: Apartments to drop 50 Nacres at that point, enabling Shii interaction
